text: Installed final standalone zarr4s commit 2a5ba963b151b62c739d1bf5a19d49202bb6ff29. Upstream checkAll passed 306 tests across core/provider JVM and Scala.js; isolated consumer compiled on both targets; ScalaFIM default adjacent-checkout resolution passed archiveZarrJVM 18/18 and archiveZarrJS 16/16. Embedded zarr modules and generic interop tools are removed, consumers import zarr4s, and serialized org.scalafim.zarr/canonical-response identity is preserved.
